scientific_review.actual_endpoint: Binary authentic-versus-generated MRI discrimination, not clinical diagnosis or generator attribution. Existing detection task and method label are preserved.
scientific_review.contribution_locator: PDFp2/printed223 Introduction contribution list; PDFp3/printed224 Section3.1; PDFpp5-8/printed226-229 Sections4.1-4.2 and Tables1-3.

data_resource.name: MRI-Forensics
data_resource.construction: Owned prostate DICOM data converted to high-quality JPEG with DCMTK dcmj2pnm, pixel-content hashing removes duplicates, images resized to256x256. Six unconditional generator configurations each yield6306 images.
data_resource.reuse_intent: Named first contribution and explicitly provided with the framework; abstract links the dataset, code and pretrained weights to github.com/amaha7984/AIM-DWT. This is a separately described resource contribution, not merely an unnamed experiment set.
data_resource.availability_verification: Manuscript release statement inspected; actual dataset files, access terms, patient counts and release integrity were not independently downloaded or audited.

benchmark_protocol.partition: Per binary training configuration:4806 real+4806 fake train,1500 real+1500 fake validation. Cross-generator testing uses all6306 images of other synthetic generators; same-generator cells are blank because that generator was exhausted by train/validation.
benchmark_protocol.metrics: Table2 measures generated-image recognition accuracy only. Separate cross-dataset brain evaluation reports real accuracy, fake accuracy and ROC AUC.
benchmark_protocol.external_data: 7023 real brain MRIs from cited Nickparvar2021 resource, plus7023 synthetic examples for each of ProGAN andDiT-XL/2; prostate-trained weights reused without brain retraining.
benchmark_protocol.R2_reason: The paper contributes a named, reusable medical forensic testbed together with explicit cross-generator and cross-domain comparisons, partition sizes, baselines and metrics. These concrete evaluation provisions, not result-table size or the authors' benchmark label alone, support R2.

quantitative_evidence.finding: DiT-XL/2 FID15.3322; ProGAN KID0.0028±0.00028. These are generation quality statistics, not detector metrics.

ProGAN-trained AIM-DWT reports100.0 fake-recognition accuracy for all five other generator columns. DiT-XL/2-trained AIM-DWT gives78.43 on ProGAN and99.81 onStyleGANv2. RAR-XXL-trained AIM-DWT gives3.50 onProGAN, whereas AIDE gives13.08 in that cell.

ProGAN-trained AIM-DWT: real97.38/fake100.0/AUC100.0 against both brain fake families. DiT-XL/2-trained AIM-DWT against ProGAN brain fakes: real99.35/fake99.26/AUC99.96; againstDiT brain fakes: real99.35/fake99.99/AUC100.0.

evidence_to_claim.support: Explicit first contribution, construction/curation and named reusable released resource; Sections1 and3.1.
Resource intended for method evaluation with specific partitions, cross-generator/cross-domain protocol, baselines and real/fake/AUC outputs in Section4.2.

limitations_and_conflicts.finding: Table2 is fake-only class recognition;100% there does not establish balanced real/fake accuracy, specificity or a low false-positive rate. All6306 prostate real images are allocated to train/validation. Table3 separately supplies real-class results on brain images.

No patient-level split, patient count or independent clinical provenance audit is established by the reviewed construction text. Generator training/source overlaps and actual release/license were not independently reproduced.

PDFp7/printed228 says RINE slightly outperforms AIM-DWT detecting ProGAN in one setting; Table2's displayed ProGAN test-column comparisons do not show that ordering. Preserve the text/table disagreement; do not repair the source or infer an undisplayed experiment.
Unconditional256x256 prostate/brain experiments do not demonstrate conditional generation, higher-resolution images or all MRI modalities; limitations are acknowledged on PDFpp7-8.

proposed_B4_action: Accept dataset and benchmark additions only through an independently justified formal R1/R2 decision; preserve detection and method. Contribution support does not validate or independently reproduce reported performance.

actual_effort.timing_basis: Shared wave/reviewer wall span, not exclusive analyst hours. Individual focused timers were not instrumented before source recovery; no invented person-minute allocations.
